description: Run the lookup previewed by spur_plan_property_data and return the updated values with their sources. Can spend the user's credits and provider costs. Requires the user's explicit approval of the preview (confirm=true). A provider with no record is never charged and never silently replaced by another one.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user explicitly approved this exact action in the conversation. Never assume approval.

items.description: Data point key, e.g. physical.bedrooms or financial.estimated_equity. Call spur_list_data_providers to see keys.

name: spur_refresh_property_data
title: Fetch property data from providers
